title: Consecration of Aaron and His Sons

questions.question: Who assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting for the consecration?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:3-4 (ESV): "Assemble all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting."

questions.question: What did Moses do to Aaron and his sons first?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:6 (ESV): "And Moses brought Aaron and his sons and washed them with water."

questions.question: What garment was put on Aaron?
options: The coat, sash, robe, ephod, and breastpiece
questions.correctAnswer: The coat, sash, robe, ephod, and breastpiece
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:7-8 (ESV): "He put the coat on him and tied the sash on him and clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him... and placed the breastpiece on him."

questions.question: What was poured on Aaron's head?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:12 (ESV): "And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him."

questions.question: How long did Aaron and his sons stay at the entrance of the tent?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:35 (ESV): "At the entrance of the tent of meeting you shall remain day and night for seven days."

questions.question: Where was the blood of the ram of ordination put on Aaron and his sons?
options: Right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe
Left ear, left hand, left foot
questions.correctAnswer: Right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:23 (ESV): "Put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot."

questions.question: What was the bull used for in the ceremony?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:14 (ESV): "Then he brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering."

questions.question: What was the first ram used for?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:18 (ESV): "Then he presented the ram of the burnt offering."

questions.question: What was the second ram called?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:22 (ESV): "Then he presented the other ram, the ram of ordination."

questions.question: What was done with the flesh of the ram of ordination?
options: Boiled and eaten by Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the tent
questions.correctAnswer: Boiled and eaten by Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the tent
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:31 (ESV): "Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket."

questions.question: What was sprinkled on Aaron and his garments along with anointing oil?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:30 (ESV): "Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood... and sprinkled it on Aaron and his garments."

questions.question: What items were put in the breastpiece?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:8 (ESV): "And in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim."

questions.question: What was Moses' role in this ceremony?
options: He performed the sacrifices and anointing
questions.correctAnswer: He performed the sacrifices and anointing
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:6-30 describes Moses performing every action of the ceremony as God commanded.

questions.question: What happened to the remains of the meat and bread?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:32 (ESV): "What remains of the flesh and the bread you shall burn with fire."

questions.question: What title is given to the basket of bread used?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 8:26 (ESV): "From the basket of unleavened bread... he took one unleavened loaf..."

key_verse_text: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.
